name: breakdown
label: Breakdown (specs, product reviews, analyses)
description: Technical walkthrough of a product, car or market: detail B-roll and on-screen stats per item.

stock._comment: B-roll hints: first matching line wins. Left side = words separated by | (whole-word match, case-insensitive).

llmGuidance: Breakdown / review video (automotive specs, product reviews, restorations, market analyses). Prefer close-up detail shots of the thing being described (engine bay, dashboard, circuit board, material texture). When the narration gives specs or numbers, use a spec_card with 2-4 short lines; never invent specs.
